body.source:
id: parity_parent
namespace: exomachina.kestra_parity
tasks:
  - id: child
    type: io.kestra.plugin.core.flow.Subflow
    namespace: exomachina.kestra_parity
    flowId: parity_child
    revision: 1
    wait: true
    transmitFailed: true
  - id: observed
    type: io.kestra.plugin.core.debug.Return
    format: "{{ outputs.child.outputs.public_result }}"
outputs:
  - id: public_result
    type: STRING
    value: "{{ outputs.observed.value }}"
